world.bio: Used to fight at Lumpinee as a teenager and into my twenties, now coach at a small gym off Sukhumvit Soi 26. Most of my students are foreigners, a lot of them beginners. Over the past year more Chinese students have been signing up, and I can't say a lot to them besides 'again' and 'good'.
skills_assets: Fought around sixty bouts, including Lumpinee, before retiring at 28
Teaches beginners, fitness classes and private pad work
Knows how to build a fighter's conditioning from scratch
A small gym with about forty regular students
Instagram account with 12k followers, mostly foreigners

projects.name: Gym class schedule
projects.text: Reorganising the timetable: morning adult fitness at 7, noon beginner class, evening pad work. We have three trainers and one office manager, Khun Noi, who handles bookings in English.

projects.name: House in Buriram
projects.text: Saving to build a house on my family's land in Buriram. I have around 400,000 baht, need about 1.2 million. Probably five more years.

notes.text: Shoulder hurts when I throw the left hook on the pads. Physio says rest. I can't rest, I have eight classes this week.

Three new Chinese students joined this week. One kid, maybe twenty, said through Google Translate that he wants to 'become strong like in the movies'. I laughed. We need to talk about waivers: I only have English and Thai versions.
Boy starts first grade in November. School uniform, shoes, books, everything. Khun Noi says budget about 12,000 baht. His mother and I argued about the school. She wants the one near her mum.
Class sheet is all in English. A Chinese woman asked what time the beginner class starts and I pointed at the board. She pointed at her phone. We both laughed. This is happening more every week.
Called my father in Buriram. He asked when I'm coming back to farm. I said not yet. He sighed.
Gym rent is due and two members haven't paid. I'm not going to chase them. Gym is mostly full on weekends, empty on weekday afternoons.
I used to run six kilometres every morning before fights. Now I do two and feel it in the shoulder. Getting old, bro.

A Chinese student's friend wanted to sign up. I told her to come Saturday. She showed me a WeChat message in Chinese and I don't know what it said. I replied 'Ok, welcome.' Hope it was the right answer.

messages.text:
Noi: Three new people want to join the 6pm class.
Me: Are they Chinese?
Noi: Yes, two from Shanghai, one from Chengdu. They keep sending me voice messages in Chinese.
Me: Ask them in English if they can write.

Mon: School tour is next Saturday.
Me: I have two classes but I will try.
Mon: Please try. He asks about you.

Ann: Come in next Thursday. Ice the shoulder, no hooks for ten days.
Me: I teach pads every day.
Ann: Then teach with the right hand.

Tom: Chai, can I bring a friend to the 7am class?
Me: Yes. First class free.
Tom: Legend.

calendar.event: Morning class 7am, then gym staff meeting

relations.about: Runs the front desk; speaks decent English, no Chinese.
Six years old, starting grade one in November.

constraints: Shoulder limits overhead pad work for ten days
Can't take unpaid weeks, gym rent is fixed
Doesn't write much in English, mostly speaks
Won't put prices up for beginners
sensitive: Savings are only about a third of what the house will need
Shoulder might need surgery, not told anyone
Tension with his son's mother about the school
